identity: A workflow editor with a component palette, a canvas of connected steps, and a settings inspector for individual steps.

scenarios.name: connect
scenarios.screen: Several named steps and their existing connections are on the canvas. The requested connection is absent; no step or connection is selected, and the settings inspector and menus are closed.
never: The requested connection is already drawn.
A connection is being dragged between ports.
A settings inspector is open.
A context menu is open.

arrangements.text: The component palette sits to the left of the canvas, with the workflow steps and their connections spread across the canvas.
The canvas sits to the left of the component palette, with the same workflow positions and connections inside it.

scenarios.name: place
scenarios.screen: The component palette sits beside a canvas containing several named steps and existing connections. The requested new step and its outgoing connection are absent; nothing is selected, and the settings inspector and menus are closed.
never: The requested new step is already on the canvas.
A palette item is floating over the canvas.
The requested outgoing connection is already drawn.
A settings inspector is open.

arrangements.text: The component palette sits to the left of the canvas, while the existing steps occupy the canvas to its right.
The canvas sits to the left of the component palette, with the existing steps in their workflow positions.

scenarios.name: reroute
scenarios.screen: Several named steps appear on the canvas with their existing connections, including the connection that needs rerouting. Its replacement connection is absent; nothing is selected, and the settings inspector and menus are closed.
never: The connection already ends at its requested destination.
A connection endpoint is being dragged.
A connection is selected.
A context menu is open.

arrangements.text: The component palette sits to the left of the canvas, where the original connection runs between its two steps.
The canvas sits to the left of the component palette, with the original connection in the same position among the steps.

scenarios.name: remove
scenarios.screen: Several named steps and existing connections are on the canvas. The step or connection named for removal is still present; nothing is selected, and the settings inspector and menus are closed.
never: The named step or connection has already been removed.
A deletion confirmation dialog is open.
A context menu is open.
The item to remove is selected.

arrangements.text: The component palette sits to the left of the canvas, with the item to remove among the workflow steps and connections on the canvas.
The canvas sits to the left of the component palette, with the item to remove in its workflow position.

scenarios.name: configure
scenarios.screen: Several named steps and their connections are on the canvas, including the step whose settings need updating. No step is selected, so its settings inspector and fields are closed; the requested values have not been saved.
never: The target step's settings inspector is open.
A settings field is being edited.
A field choice menu is open.
The requested values are already saved.

arrangements.text: The component palette sits to the left of the canvas, with the step to configure among the connected steps on the canvas.
The canvas sits to the left of the component palette, with the step to configure in its workflow position.
